mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_product_sales WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND subscription_status = 'COMPLETE'

SELECT s.subscription_no AS subscription_no, s.member_no AS member_no, s.product_no AS product_no, s.account_no AS account_no, s.subscription_amount AS subscription_amount, s.applied_interest_rate AS applied_interest_rate, s.subscribed_at AS subscribed_at, s.maturity_date AS maturity_date, s.subscription_status AS subscription_status, p.product_name AS product_name, p.product_type AS product_type FROM tb_product_sales s JOIN tb_product p ON s.product_no = p.product_no JOIN TB_BANK_MEMBER M ON S.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE M.LOGIN_ID = #{username} ORDER BY s.subscribed_at DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT s.SUBSCRIPTION_NO, s.MEMBER_NO, s.PRODUCT_NO, s.ACCOUNT_NO, s.JOIN_CHANNEL, s.APPLIED_INTEREST_RATE, s.SUBSCRIPTION_MONTHS, s.SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT, s.AUTO_TRANSFER_AMOUNT, s.LINKED_ACCOUNT_ID, s.SUBSCRIBED_AT, s.MATURITY_DATE, s.SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS, s.REQUIRED_TERMS_AGREED, s.OPTIONAL_TERMS_AGREED, s.CREATED_AT, s.UPDATED_AT, p.PRODUCT_NAME, p.PRODUCT_TYPE FROM TB_PRODUCT_SALES s JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON s.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO WHERE s.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND s.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND s.SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS = 'DRAFT' ORDER BY s.UPDATED_AT DESC NULLS LAST, s.CREATED_AT DESC NULLS LAST, s.SUBSCRIPTION_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT s.SUBSCRIPTION_NO, s.MEMBER_NO, s.PRODUCT_NO, s.ACCOUNT_NO, s.JOIN_CHANNEL, s.APPLIED_INTEREST_RATE, s.SUBSCRIPTION_MONTHS, s.SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT, s.AUTO_TRANSFER_AMOUNT, s.LINKED_ACCOUNT_ID, s.SUBSCRIBED_AT, s.MATURITY_DATE, s.SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS, s.REQUIRED_TERMS_AGREED, s.OPTIONAL_TERMS_AGREED, s.CREATED_AT, s.UPDATED_AT, p.PRODUCT_NAME, p.PRODUCT_TYPE FROM TB_PRODUCT_SALES s JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON s.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO WHERE s.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND s.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} ORDER BY CASE s.SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS WHEN 'COMPLETE' THEN 1 WHEN 'DRAFT' THEN 2 WHEN 'EXPIRED' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, s.UPDATED_AT DESC NULLS LAST, s.CREATED_AT DESC NULLS LAST, s.SUBSCRIPTION_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT s.SUBSCRIPTION_NO, s.MEMBER_NO, s.PRODUCT_NO, s.ACCOUNT_NO, s.JOIN_CHANNEL, s.APPLIED_INTEREST_RATE, s.SUBSCRIPTION_MONTHS, s.SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT, s.AUTO_TRANSFER_AMOUNT, s.LINKED_ACCOUNT_ID, s.SUBSCRIBED_AT, s.MATURITY_DATE, s.SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS, s.REQUIRED_TERMS_AGREED, s.OPTIONAL_TERMS_AGREED, s.CREATED_AT, s.UPDATED_AT, p.PRODUCT_NAME, p.PRODUCT_TYPE FROM TB_PRODUCT_SALES s JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON s.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO WHERE s.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND s.SUBSCRIPTION_NO = #{subscriptionNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PRODUCT_SALES ( MEMBER_NO, PRODUCT_NO, JOIN_CHANNEL, SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS, REQUIRED_TERMS_AGREED, OPTIONAL_TERMS_AGREED, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{memberNo}, #{productNo}, 'MOBILE', 'DRAFT', 1, 0, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PRODUCT_SALES SET REQUIRED_TERMS_AGREED = #{requiredTermsAgreed}, OPTIONAL_TERMS_AGREED = #{optionalTermsAgreed}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND SUBSCRIPTION_NO = #{subscriptionNo} AND SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE TB_PRODUCT_SALES SET LINKED_ACCOUNT_ID = #{linkedAccountId}, SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT = #{subscriptionAmount}, SUBSCRIPTION_MONTHS = #{subscriptionMonths}, AUTO_TRANSFER_AMOUNT = #{autoTransferAmount}, APPLIED_INTEREST_RATE = #{appliedInterestRate}, MATURITY_DATE = ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, #{subscriptionMonths}), UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND SUBSCRIPTION_NO = #{subscriptionNo} AND SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE TB_PRODUCT_SALES SET ACCOUNT_NO = #{accountNo}, APPLIED_INTEREST_RATE = #{appliedInterestRate}, SUBSCRIBED_AT = SYSDATE, MATURITY_DATE = #{maturityDate}, SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS = 'COMPLETE', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND SUBSCRIPTION_NO = #{subscriptionNo} AND SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS = 'DRAFT'
